nodes.note: on-chip resistive aggressor heater 'adjacent to a MRM' (LM26-P section 3.2) beside ring 0; position unpublished. The default site 'aggressor' is at (0, -30) um: 30 um from ring 0, and every ring-to-site distance is the same as at the former (0, 30) um, so the A1/A2 calibrations in ring units do not change. It is 55 um from ring 0's monitor PD (ring.thermal.pd_offset_um (0, 25) um). It moved from (0, 30) um, 5 um from that PD, because there the calibrated A1 power heats the PD past ~600 degC, which is not physical for a real layout. The former position stays as the site 'aggressor_pd_adjacent' for the stress scenarios a1_slide10_aggressor_pd_adjacent and a2_808_aggressor_pd_adjacent only (monitor dark-current runaway); with no scenario power it adds no heat. The new site is at the same point as ring 0's driver site (ring.thermal.driver_offset_um (0, -30) um): both are heat sources, so the model adds them, but a real layout cannot put both there

nodes.label: jacobian_coupling
nodes.meaning: second Jacobian block (coupling artefact)
nodes.note: d ln K^2 of the through and drop couplers per nm of width, film, slab and their own edge-to-edge gaps, at 1310 nm and fixed gaps and r_ref (07 P1-16; method A CMT, 2-D full-wave checked for rib160). Partial derivatives at fixed edge-to-edge gaps: variation.geometry.width_closes_gaps makes a width error close both gaps by the same amount (the artefact's note: total = d/dw - d/dgap; through -0.0145 + 0.0135 = -0.0010 /nm, drop -0.0189 + 0.0141 = -0.0048 /nm). realize moves the per-pass couplings of the nominal-geometry device (the R4 anchors) by it and by the coupler dispersion times the resonance move (mrm.params.relations R4_q). The 200 nm film world keeps these 160 nm couplers (as it keeps their dispersion): the rib200 couplers have no 2-D full-wave check

nodes.label: depletion_exponent
nodes.meaning: m of dlambda = A*((V+Vbi)^m - Vbi^m).
